raw_tweets.text:
i gave Grok Bot $75 and told it "earn your keep or get shut off"

48 hours later it's sitting on $6,140

still running

autonomous trading agent on the platform

I didn't touch a line of code - it lives on its own cloud box with its own browser and terminal, working while I'm asleep

every 20 minutes it:

> pulls every weather market with a resolution date inside the next 10 days
> cross-checks the current price against the latest forecast update
> only opens a position once the forecast and the market disagree by enough to matter
> sizes up based on how wide that disagreement is
> places the trade on its own, no approval step
> covers its own hosting bill straight out of profits

if it ever hits $0, the subscription gets cut - it's done for good

hour nine it was down to $14. it dropped every multi-day market it was holding and switched to same-day resolution only

so it changed its own strategy to stay alive

setup took one evening: spin up the bot, run one trade in front of it, put it on a timer, hook up a wallet

no VPS. no API keys. no dev on call.

I paid a freelancer $4,000 to build something like this last year. it never made it past a demo

Grok Bot did in one evening what two months of freelancers couldn't

$75 → $6,140 in 48 hours

what's it sitting at by Friday?

- OpenAI leaders believe they are at the cusp of AGI.  Sam Altman believes OpenAI will have an internal system that will qualify as AGI by the end of 2026.  Mark Chen thinks OpenAI is 80% of the way to AGI.

- OpenAI already has the automated AI research intern - that's Astra.  Jakub Pachocki says that Astra "can implement an experimental idea inside OpenAI’s code base, run the experiment, and return results, or take a paper and perform work that previously occupied a human researcher for a week".
